environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the OrderEventProcessor. The task role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/order-processor-role) has broad permissions: sqs:ReceiveMessage, sqs:DeleteMessage on the queue, and dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan on the OrderEvents table with no condition keys. The SQS queue is a standard queue with no message attribute filtering or content-based validation. Any producer with sqs:SendMessage can set arbitrary message attributes including 'routingRule'. JVM runs with no SecurityManager. Spring Expression Language (SpEL) 5.3.x with full type access enabled (default StandardEvaluationContext).

config.sqs_policy: Allow sqs:SendMessage to any authenticated AWS principal
config.network: VPC with outbound internet access via NAT gateway
